amends: ci-prospective/PREREG_ci_prospective.json (commit 607ba1e, frozen 2026-10-07T09:18:41Z). The original registration is unchanged; this adds arms.
statement: Written before any failure from the prospective window (2026-10-07T09:18:41Z to 2026-10-21T00:00:00Z) was crawled or viewed.
why: After the 2026-10-07 freeze, the CI outcome model was found to be misspecified (retriggers treated as independent, one flakiness rate per suite). The repaired model was developed on the train window only; the retrospective test window was then scored twice (v3t once frozen, then v4t as a labelled second look). This registration lets the prospective window, which no one has seen, decide.

new_arms.dp_v4t (primary new arm): ci_triage3.DP4 built by ci_triage3.build() on the analysis sample before 2026-09-06 plus the crawl's detail rows before 2026-09-06; belief recalibrated with ci_calib_v4.json (Platt map fitted on train-window failures with real retrigger outcomes); finite-horizon belief DP (POMDP), depth 2
new_arms.dp_v4t_depth3 (secondary): dp_v4t allowed one extra information move (simulated scoring modes only)
new_arms.decide-step ablation (secondary): QMDP and top-guess MDP variants of dp_v4t as defined in ci_triage3.pol_qmdp / pol_mdp

unchanged: dp_v1 (original DP), best rule re-tuned on train under each scoring mode, Qwen and Opus LLM controllers with the frozen prompts, costs, the week-2 price change (macOS x5, Windows x2 from 2026-10-14), sampling of failures, label cut-off 2026-10-23.

scoring_modes.original: as registered: real same-push retrigger outcomes when observed, otherwise drawn from the frozen v1 odds
scoring_modes.world: real outcomes when observed, otherwise drawn from a per-test beta-binomial fitted on all data available at scoring time (train, test and prospective windows), conditional on the outcomes observed for that failure
scoring_modes.real_only: only failures whose first two retrigger outcomes were observed; real outcomes only (a stress test of the outcome model: these failures were selected by Mozilla retriggering them at least twice)

predictions.A1: original and world modes, each week: dp_v4t minus best re-tuned rule < 0 (95% push-clustered interval below zero)
predictions.A2: original and world modes, each week: dp_v4t minus each LLM controller < 0
predictions.A3: real_only mode (both weeks pooled): no directional prediction; on the retrospective test dp_v4t lost to 'retrigger once, then escalate' (14.85 vs 13.23 per failure, n = 169, interval includes zero). Reported either way.
predictions.A4: dp_v4t cost per failure in original mode falls within the forecast band below (week 1)

data_hashes_note: Frozen models are rebuilt from the analysis sample (data/treeherder/sample/sample.jsonl) and the crawl (data/treeherder/jobs, detail) as of 2026-10-06; file hashes are in ci_v4_frozen_sha256.txt (the LLM verdict file ci_llm_verdict.jsonl: e1db964c...).
